headline: Indian stock markets closed today for Diwali-Balipratipada; Sensex, Nifty extended gains in last session

marketStatus.message: Market is closed for trading today due to an NSE holiday. It will reopen on Wednesday, 11 November.

why: NSE and BSE exchanges are closed today on account of Diwali-Balipratipada.
Trading on Indian stock exchanges will resume on Wednesday, 11 November 2026.
On the last trading day, Sensex and Nifty extended gains to close at their highest levels in over eight months.
India VIX jumped 68% over three weeks despite a 7% rally in Sensex and Nifty during the same period.
whatHappening: Both NSE and BSE exchanges remain shut for trading today due to the local holiday.
Benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty closed at multi-month highs in the previous session.
Market volatility indicator India VIX spiked sharply over recent weeks alongside the market rally.
Normal trading operations will recommence on Wednesday.
summary: Indian stock markets are closed today, 10 November 2026, for Diwali-Balipratipada. In the last trading session, Sensex and Nifty extended gains to close at their highest levels in over eight months. Regular trading on NSE and BSE will resume on Wednesday, 11 November 2026.
